title: Upload
subtitle: Add workouts from files and manage your watch faces.

workouts.title: Workout files
workouts.intro: Pick .fit, .gpx or .tcx files from a watch, a bike computer or another app. The file is read in your browser; only the resulting workout is uploaded.

drop.title: Drop files here
drop.hint: FIT, GPX, TCX. Up to {{mb}} MB per file.

collision.duplicate: A workout with the same start time already exists ({{name}}). This file is skipped so it doesn't overwrite it.
collision.overlap: Its time overlaps {{name}} ({{date}}). This file is skipped.

notes.noAnalysis: The file doesn't have enough data for charts. The summary numbers are still saved.
notes.thinned: Its recording points were thinned to fit in the cloud.
notes.analysis: Charts, zones and splits are computed from the file. Comparison with your other workouts shows up after JoyoFit on your phone recomputes.

errors.unsupported: This file type isn't supported. Use .fit, .gpx or .tcx.
errors.not-fit: This isn't a valid FIT file.
errors.corrupt: The FIT file is damaged or incomplete.
errors.not-activity: This FIT file isn't a workout (it may be settings or a course).
errors.no-session: There's no workout summary in this file.
errors.no-points: There are no timed recording points in this file.
errors.invalid: This workout didn't pass the format check.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again, then retry the upload.
errors.deleted: A workout with this start time was deleted from the cloud, so it isn't uploaded again.
errors.quota: Your account's cloud storage is full.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
errors.server: The server failed to save this workout. Try again.

watchfaces.title: Watch face library
watchfaces.intro: Upload .hwt watch faces to your account. In JoyoFit on your phone, open Watch faces then From the web, and install to the watch from there.

signing.note: A Huawei watch rejects .hwt files that Huawei has not signed, and JoyoFit cannot sign them: a watch face you made yourself can be removed by the watch after it is installed. A photo face from JoyoFit on your phone works without any .hwt file.
signing.guide: Guide to installing through Huawei Health (in Indonesian)

drop.title: Drop watch faces here
drop.hint: .hwt files. Up to {{mb}} MB per file, up to {{max}} watch faces.

list.label: Watch faces in your library
list.emptyBody: Upload a .hwt file above, then install it from JoyoFit on your phone: Watch faces, From the web.

errors.library_full: Your library is full (up to {{max}} watch faces). Delete one first.
errors.paywall: Uploading watch faces needs JoyoRogo Pro. The ones you already have can still be downloaded and deleted.
